preseason_hypothesis: Brady continues to call the offensive plays as head coach without diluting the offense
confirming_evidence: RESOLVED 2026-08-20 — Brady confirmed as play-caller from day one as HC; Carmichael prepares as backup caller and is testing booth vs sideline across the two preseason games; starters scored on both opening-drive possessions in the 2026-08-15 opener
disconfirming_evidence: play-calling handed to Carmichael; operational or tempo issues early

preseason_hypothesis: Carmichael's influence changes passing-game detail and situational menus without altering the base identity
confirming_evidence: new third-down/red-zone concepts; adjusted protection answers; same core system
disconfirming_evidence: offense looks materially different; base identity changes

preseason_hypothesis: Moore becomes Buffalo's clearest perimeter WR1 and highest-volume target
confirming_evidence: first-team outside routes; leads receiver targets; red-zone looks
disconfirming_evidence: committee caps his share; another receiver leads targets

preseason_hypothesis: Buffalo distributes targets rather than producing a receiver above a 25 percent target share
confirming_evidence: targets rotate by personnel and situation; no receiver separates
disconfirming_evidence: one receiver exceeds 25 percent across four representative games

preseason_hypothesis: Shakir retains the highest receiver route floor and third-down role
confirming_evidence: leads slot snaps; stays on field in two-minute and third down
disconfirming_evidence: loses slot/third-down work to another receiver

preseason_hypothesis: Coleman earns a full-time boundary role with red-zone value
confirming_evidence: stable outside snaps; contested-catch and red-zone targets
disconfirming_evidence: rotation by package; separation or trust limits snaps

preseason_hypothesis: Kincaid's route participation supports a middle-field passing role
confirming_evidence: routes on a majority of dropbacks; targets at multiple depths
disconfirming_evidence: route rate stays capped; Knox/Hawes absorb tight-end targets
review_trigger: after two games with route charting

preseason_hypothesis: Cook remains the clear lead back in both run and pass phases
confirming_evidence: RESOLVED 2026-08-20 — Reigning NFL rushing champion returns as unquestioned lead back; played both first-team possessions in the 2026-08-15 preseason opener (5 carries, 21 yards, 15 team snaps); no RB added by trade, draft, or free agency; Davis/Johnson/Gore Jr. roles reported as non-conflicting
disconfirming_evidence: committee reduces early-down share; passing-down role shifts away

preseason_hypothesis: Carmichael's arrival expands rather than trims Cook's receiving usage
confirming_evidence: Carmichael has stated an intent to use Cook more extensively as a receiver, with angle routes and motion-adjusted deeper concepts described; Cook career 130 receptions on 164 targets
disconfirming_evidence: 2025 receiving volume DECLINED to 33 receptions/291 yards from 44/445 in 2024; 8.4 percent target share in an offense 25th in pass attempts (29.1/game); no charted 2026 route data yet
review_trigger: route participation and targets across the first four regular-season games

preseason_hypothesis: Allen's short-yardage and goal-line rushing caps the backfield touchdown ceiling, but less tightly than in 2023
confirming_evidence: Allen rushed for 14 TD on 112 carries in 2025 and remains the primary goal-line runner
disconfirming_evidence: Cook took 24 goal-line carries (8th in NFL) with a reported red-zone touch share near 40 percent, and scored 16 then 12 rushing TD in 2024-2025; the cap is loosening rather than binding
review_trigger: red-zone and goal-line carry charting for both Allen and Cook after four regular-season games

preseason_hypothesis: The interior line stabilizes at center and left guard before Week 1
confirming_evidence: McGovern returns for Week 1 as targeted and a single left guard holds the first-team job
disconfirming_evidence: McGovern (lower body, since 2026-08-08, reported 2-4 weeks) misses regular-season time; left guard still rotating between Anderson and Corbett in late preseason
review_trigger: preseason game two on 2026-08-22 and the Week 1 injury report

preseason_hypothesis: Cook's Weeks 1-5 efficiency is suppressed by schedule and interior-line churn while his workload holds
confirming_evidence: Snap share and touch count stay at 2025 levels while yards per carry lags; Buffalo RB early-season SOS ranks hardest in the league (avg opponent rank 26.4 across HOU, DET, LAC, NE, LAR)
disconfirming_evidence: Workload itself contracts, or efficiency holds despite the slate
review_trigger: after five regular-season games, with snap and touch charting

preseason_hypothesis: Meyer's positional-versatility approach holds up: a swing-type left guard performs adequately and the run game stays top-tier
confirming_evidence: Anderson (or a kicked-inside tackle) holds left guard with stable play; yards before contact stays near the 2025 mark of 3.1 and run-block win rate near 74.7 percent
disconfirming_evidence: Left guard rotates into the regular season; interior displacement fails in short yardage and duo concepts; Corbett replaces Anderson
review_trigger: Weeks 1-4 with yards-before-contact and run-block win rate charted against 2025 baselines
